====================================================================================================
Casts to decimals

Each case runs as CAST. TRY_CAST follows a case only when CAST fails at runtime, to show which rows
become NULL. Where CAST succeeds, TRY_CAST is checked to return the same values and is not listed;
where CAST fails type checking, TRY_CAST is checked to fail it too.
====================================================================================================


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Strings to decimals

A string parses as a decimal of the target precision and scale, with or without an exponent. A value
that needs more digits than the precision allows fails.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST('010.010' AS DECIMAL(5,3))
raw expr       : CAST('010.010' AS Decimal(5, 3))
checked expr   : CAST<String>("010.010" AS Decimal(5, 3))
optimized expr : 10.010_d64(5,3)
output type    : Decimal(5, 3)
output domain  : {10.010..=10.010}
output         : 10.010


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST('010.010' AS DECIMAL(5,4))
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Decimal overflow while evaluating function `to_decimal(5, 4)('010.010')` in expr `CAST('010.010' AS Decimal(5, 4))`



ast            : TRY_CAST('010.010' AS DECIMAL(5,4))
raw expr       : TRY_CAST('010.010' AS Decimal(5, 4))
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<String>("010.010" AS Decimal(5, 4) NULL)
optimized expr : NULL
output type    : Decimal(5, 4) NULL
output domain  : {NULL}
output         : NULL


ast            : CAST('010.010' AS DECIMAL(5,2))

optimized expr : 10.01_d64(5,2)
output type    : Decimal(5, 2)
output domain  : {10.01..=10.01}
output         : 10.01

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to_decimal(precision, scale)

`to_decimal(p, s)(x)` converts a number, boolean or decimal to `Decimal(p, s)`. A float converts
from its binary value, so `123.45::FLOAT32` is `123.44` with scale 2.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : to_decimal(10, 3)(123.456)
raw expr       : to_decimal(10, 3)(123.456)
checked expr   : CAST<Decimal(6, 3)>(123.456_d64(6,3) AS Decimal(10, 3))
optimized expr : 123.456_d64(10,3)
output type    : Decimal(10, 3)
output domain  : {123.456..=123.456}
output         : 123.456


ast            : to_decimal(10, 3)(-123.456)
raw expr       : to_decimal(10, 3)(-123.456)
checked expr   : CAST<Decimal(6, 3)>(-123.456_d64(6,3) AS Decimal(10, 3))
optimized expr : -123.456_d64(10,3)
output type    : Decimal(10, 3)
output domain  : {-123.456..=-123.456}
output         : -123.456


ast            : to_decimal(12, 1)(-9876.5)
raw expr       : to_decimal(12, 1)(-9876.5)
checked expr   : CAST<Decimal(5, 1)>(-9876.5_d64(5,1) AS Decimal(12, 1))
optimized expr : -9876.5_d64(12,1)
output type    : Decimal(12, 1)
output domain  : {-9876.5..=-9876.5}
output         : -9876.5


ast            : to_decimal(6, 2)(5)
raw expr       : to_decimal(6, 2)(5)
checked expr   : CAST<UInt8>(5_u8 AS Decimal(6, 2))
optimized expr : 5.00_d64(6,2)
output type    : Decimal(6, 2)
output domain  : {5.00..=5.00}
output         : 5.00


ast            : to_decimal(6, 2)(-5)
raw expr       : to_decimal(6, 2)(-5)
checked expr   : CAST<Int8>(-5_i8 AS Decimal(6, 2))
optimized expr : -5.00_d64(6,2)
output type    : Decimal(6, 2)
output domain  : {-5.00..=-5.00}
output         : -5.00


ast            : to_decimal(6, 2)(true)
raw expr       : to_decimal(6, 2)(true)
checked expr   : CAST<Boolean>(true AS Decimal(6, 2))
optimized expr : 1.00_d64(6,2)
output type    : Decimal(6, 2)
output domain  : {1.00..=1.00}
output         : 1.00


ast            : to_decimal(10, 2)(123.45::FLOAT32)
raw expr       : to_decimal(10, 2)(CAST(123.45 AS Float32))
checked expr   : CAST<Float32>(CAST<Decimal(5, 2)>(123.45_d64(5,2) AS Float32) AS Decimal(10, 2))
optimized expr : 123.44_d64(10,2)
output type    : Decimal(10, 2)
output domain  : {123.44..=123.44}
output         : 123.44


ast            : to_decimal(10, 2)(-123.45::FLOAT32)
raw expr       : to_decimal(10, 2)(minus(CAST(123.45 AS Float32)))
checked expr   : CAST<Float32>(minus<Float32>(CAST<Decimal(5, 2)>(123.45_d64(5,2) AS Float32)) AS Decimal(10, 2))
optimized expr : -123.44_d64(10,2)
output type    : Decimal(10, 2)
output domain  : {-123.44..=-123.44}
output         : -123.44


ast            : to_decimal(12, 4)(123.456::DECIMAL(9,3))
raw expr       : to_decimal(12, 4)(CAST(123.456 AS Decimal(9, 3)))
checked expr   : CAST<Decimal(9, 3)>(CAST<Decimal(6, 3)>(123.456_d64(6,3) AS Decimal(9, 3)) AS Decimal(12, 4))
optimized expr : 123.4560_d64(12,4)
output type    : Decimal(12, 4)
output domain  : {123.4560..=123.4560}
output         : 123.4560


ast            : to_decimal(12, 4)(-123.456::DECIMAL(9,3))
raw expr       : to_decimal(12, 4)(minus(CAST(123.456 AS Decimal(9, 3))))
checked expr   : CAST<Decimal(9, 3)>(minus<Decimal(9, 3)>(CAST<Decimal(6, 3)>(123.456_d64(6,3) AS Decimal(9, 3))) AS Decimal(12, 4))
optimized expr : -123.4560_d64(12,4)
output type    : Decimal(12, 4)
output domain  : {-123.4560..=-123.4560}
output         : -123.4560


ast            : to_decimal(12, 4)(a)
raw expr       : to_decimal(12, 4)(a::Float64)
checked expr   : CAST<Float64>(a AS Decimal(12, 4))
